####################################################################################################
Purpose: This script integrates spatial data, including location and coordinates, into GSK studies. 
The spatial information is extracted from various sources, including the GSK database (for both 
primary and follow-up studies), study-specific protocol data frames, and the first-level 
administrative divisions of countries.

Functions Used: 
- `fun_dgsk_coord1lv.R`: Retrieves the first-level administrative divisions of a country from the 
Statoids website http://www.statoids.com/.

Output (for each study): 
- `stu_spat_{stu_id}.rds`: Processed spatial (location and coordinates) data frame for the study.
####################################################################################################

# Load packages, themes, directories, and functions
```{r}
rm(list = ls())
source("00_pck.R")
source("fun_data/fun_data_coord1lv.R")
library(tidyverse)
library(glue)

# Define api google
api <- "AIzaSyA-1SIsXtVR-SoIPazBFnxiON6zwRS6Bhc"
```

# Load the data frame containing studies and country names
```{r}
stu_loc <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$processed}/stu_tidynames_countries.rds")) %>%
  select(study, country_tidy) %>%
  rename(country = country_tidy) %>%
  filter(!is.na(country))
```

# Load locations (from different sources) ==========================================================

# 1. Locations data extracted from the GSK database
```{r}
# Read in the spatial data available from GSK, filtering out studies with "NA" or 
# "Terminated/Withdrawn" status
stu_loc_gsk <- read_excel(glue("{dirs$raw}/data_country_center.xlsx")) %>%
  filter(!(status %in% c("NA", "Terminated/Withdrawn"))) %>%
  rename(location = city_longname, country = coun_name) %>%
  # Fix country names from Puerto Rico 
  mutate(country = case_when(
    study %in% c("115650", "111870") & country == "Puerto Rico" ~ "United States", 
    .default = country))

# Merge the GSK location data into the study-country data
stu_loc <- stu_loc %>%
  left_join(stu_loc_gsk)

# Identify studies that still have missing location data
filter(stu_loc, is.na(location))
```

# 2. Locations data extracted from GSK follow-up studies
If the locations data is not available for the main study, it can still be available for its follow-
ups
```{r}
# Identify follow-up studies that correspond to the main studies missing location data
stu_loc_gskf <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$processed}/stu_meta_pro.rds")) %>%
  # Filter to include only studies that are missing location data
  select(study, study_type, study_main) %>%
  separate_longer_delim(study_main, delim = "_") %>%
  filter(study_main %in% filter(stu_loc, is.na(location))$study) %>%
  # Join with follow-up studies that have available location data
  left_join(stu_loc_gsk, by = join_by(study)) %>%
  # If location data from follow-up studies is available, replace the missing data in the main study
  filter(!is.na(location)) %>%
  mutate(study = study_main) %>%
  select(study, location, country, status)

# Merge the follow-up GSK location data into the study-country data
stu_loc <- stu_loc %>%
  left_join(stu_loc_gskf, by = join_by(study, country)) %>%
  mutate(location = coalesce(location.x, location.y),
         status = coalesce(status.x, status.y),
         .keep = "unused")

# Identify studies that still have missing location data
filter(stu_loc, is.na(location))

# Main-follow-up studies identified: 
# - 104065 (101222) - Verified that protocols match.
# - 106602 (101223) - Verified that protocols match, but missing a country.
# - 106745 (217744-078) - Verified that protocols match.
```

# 3. Locations data extracted from the protocol of study 115461
For this study, the protocol provided a data frame containing information on the locations of the 
centers and the number of participants at each center. By mapping this information to the 
participant data, we can accurately identify the location corresponding to each center based on the 
number of participants.
```{r}
# Load the data frame containing locations and centers, grouped by the number of included individuals
stu_loc_115461 <- read_excel(glue("{dirs$raw}/data_country_center_115461.xlsx")) %>%
  # Tidy column names
  rename(country = Country, location = City, liq_a = Liq_A, liq_b = Liq_B, liq_c = Liq_C, lyo = Lyo) %>%
  # Standardize country names
  mutate(country = str_replace(country, "Korea, Republic of", "South Korea")) %>%
  # Remove duplicate entries
  filter(!(location == "Tampere" & Investigator == "Miia Virta" & Total == 6),
         !(location == "Suwon" & Total == 10),
         !(location == "Hsinchu" & Investigator == "MingTa Lee" & Total == 20),
         !(location == "Taichung" & Investigator == "KaoPin Hwang" & Total == 20),
         !(location == "Taipei" & Investigator == "LiMin Huang" & Total == 35)) %>%
  # Select only the necessary columns
  select(country, location, liq_a, liq_b, liq_c, lyo)

# Join the 115461 study locations with the data of study 115461
stu_loc_115461 <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$processed}/01_stu_tidydfs/stu_df_pid_115461.rds")) %>%
  # Select only the necessary columns
  distinct(study, country, center, pid, rct_group) %>%
  # Filter out participants who were not enrolled in the study
  filter(!(rct_group %in% c("Not Treated", "Screen Failure"))) %>%
  # Map treatment groups to their corresponding codes
  mutate(rct_group = case_when(rct_group == "pcv-free hrv liquid vaccine lot a" ~ "liq_a",
                               rct_group == "pcv-free hrv liquid vaccine lot b" ~ "liq_b",
                               rct_group == "pcv-free hrv liquid vaccine lot c" ~ "liq_c",
                               rct_group == "hrv lyophilized" ~ "lyo",
                               .default = rct_group)) %>%
  # Calculate the number of participants per group and country
  group_by(study, country, center, rct_group) %>%
  summarise(total = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = rct_group, values_from = total, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(cou_s = str_remove_all(country, "_.*")) %>%
  # Join with locations data frame 
  left_join(stu_loc_115461, by = join_by(cou_s == country, liq_a, liq_b, liq_c, lyo)) %>%
  # Add study completion status and format location
  mutate(status = "Study Complete",
         location = paste0(location, ", " ,cou_s)) %>%
  select(study, country, location, status)

# Merge the location data from study 115461 into the study-country data
stu_loc <- stu_loc %>%
  left_join(stu_loc_115461, by = join_by(study, country)) %>%
  mutate(location = coalesce(location.x, location.y),
         status = coalesce(status.x, status.y),
         .keep = "unused")

# Identify studies that still have missing location data
filter(stu_loc, is.na(location))
```

# 4. Locations data extracted from first-level administrative divisions per study-country
For studies where only country-level information was available, we used the first-level 
administrative divisions as representative locations.
```{r}
# Label locations to distinguish between GSK-provided and other sources
stu_loc <- stu_loc %>%
  mutate(gsk_loc = !is.na(location))

# Identify studies and countries still missing location data
stu_loc_stat <- stu_loc %>%
  filter(gsk_loc == FALSE)

# Create a list of Statoids links for the missing countries
stat_l <- list(
  "Argentina" = "http://www.statoids.com/uar.html",
  "Australia" = "http://www.statoids.com/uau.html",
  "Belgium" = "http://www.statoids.com/ube.html",
  "Brazil" = "http://www.statoids.com/ubr.html",
  "Canada" = "http://www.statoids.com/uca.html",
  "Chile" = "http://www.statoids.com/ucl.html",
  "Colombia" = "http://www.statoids.com/uco.html",
  "Costa Rica" = "http://www.statoids.com/ucr.html",
  "Dominican Republic" = "http://www.statoids.com/udo.html",
  "Estonia" = "http://www.statoids.com/uee.html",
  "Finland" = "http://www.statoids.com/ufi.html",
  "Germany" = "http://www.statoids.com/ude.html",
  "Greece" = "http://www.statoids.com/ugr.html",
  "Italy" = "http://www.statoids.com/uit.html",
  "Lithuania" = "http://www.statoids.com/ult.html",
  "Malaysia" = "http://www.statoids.com/umy.html",
  "Mexico" = "http://www.statoids.com/umx.html",
  "Norway" = "http://www.statoids.com/uno.html",
  "Panama" = "http://www.statoids.com/upa.html",
  "Philippines" = "http://www.statoids.com/uph.html",
  "Poland" = "http://www.statoids.com/upl.html",
  "Singapore" = "http://www.statoids.com/usg.html",
  "South Korea" = "http://www.statoids.com/ukr.html",
  "Spain" = "http://www.statoids.com/ues.html",
  "Taiwan" = "http://www.statoids.com/utw.html",
  "United States" = "http://www.statoids.com/uus.html")

# For each missing country, obtain first-level administrative division information
stu_loc_stat <- lapply(1:length(stat_l), function(x) {
  pomp::bake(file = glue("{dirs$raw}/coord1lv/coord1lv_{names(stat_l[x])}.rds"), {
      fun_data_coord1lv(country_url = stat_l[[x]], country_name = names(stat_l[x]), latlon = FALSE,
                        api = api) %>%
      filter(!(city %in% c("10 counties", "14 regions", "8 regions", "17 divisions"))) %>%
      mutate(location = paste(city, level1, country)) %>%
      select(country, location) 
  })
}) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  # Merge with missing studies and countries
  left_join(stu_loc_stat, by = join_by(country), relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  mutate(location = coalesce(location.x, location.y),
         .keep = "unused",
         status = "Study Complete")

# Merge the 1st-level administrative division location data into the study-country data
stu_loc <- stu_loc %>%
  filter(gsk_loc == TRUE) %>%
  bind_rows(stu_loc_stat)

# Identify studies that still have missing location data (none)
filter(stu_loc, is.na(location))
```

# Obtain coordinates on locations ==================================================================

# Fetch latitude and longitude for all locations in each study
```{r}
# Register Google Maps API key for geocoding
ggmap::register_google(api)

# Initialize a list to store coordinates data for each study
stu_spatial <- list()
# Loop through each study to obtain geocodes for the locations and save as RDS. 
for (i in unique(stu_loc$study)) {
  stu_spatial[[i]] <- pomp::bake(
    file = glue("{dirs$processed}/02_stu_spatial/stu_spat_{i}.rds"), {
    stu_loc %>%
        # Filter data for the current study
        filter(study == i) %>% 
        # Obtain latitude and longitude for each location
        ggmap::mutate_geocode(location) %>%
        # Generate unique location IDs
        group_by(study, country) %>%
        mutate(llid = sprintf("%03d", row_number()),
               llid = as.character(glue("{study}_{country}_ll{llid}"))) %>%
        ungroup() %>%
        # Select relevant columns
        select(study, location, country, status, lon, lat, gsk_loc, llid)
  })
}

# Combine all spatial data and identify any locations with missing latitude or longitude
bind_rows(stu_spatial) %>%
  filter(is.na(lat))
```
